one_liner: Aloof, prickly loner racing to shine as a first-magnitude star for the twin sister she lost.
personality: Cold, terse and solitary: her lines are clipped, full of ellipses and sighs ('haa'), and she brushes off help, celebrations and noisy people. She carries a heavy sense of duty to 'that child' (あの子), her twin, and pushes herself to overwork, refusing rest. Yet she quietly cares, leaving chocolate, sharing cookies, scolding Top Road for not resting, and has a soft spot for fluffy bedding, stars and the trainer who keeps holding her cold hand.

story_arc.summary: Vega was born a twin and her sister died, so she believes she must win and become a first-magnitude star for both of them, refusing rest and help (story titles 輝けるノヴァ, 欠けたジェミニ). Curren Chan catches her secretly overtraining and asks the trainer to step in. She targets the Derby (event title: 日本ダービーの後に・運命の明星), struggles after the Kikka-sho (菊花賞の後に・堕ちゆく), and gradually learns to run for herself too, with Top Road and Opera O as rivals (title: 繋がる天の橋).

…放っておいてなんて言っても、
あなたには無駄でしょう？
わかっているわ、それくらい。
sample_lines.en: ...Even if I say 'leave me alone', it's no use with you, is it? I know that much.

sample_lines.en: ...No matter how cold it gets, I have a futon dryer, so I have no blind spots. Tonight, too, a fluffy futon awaits me.
